name: ideation-hub
description: Connect coding agents to Ideation Hub, a requirements traceability workspace. Includes the Ideation Hub MCP server and three skills: ideation-hub-platform (schema, REST, and MCP reference), ideation-hub-requirements-agent (write and trace Business Needs, User Needs, and Product Requirements), and ideation-hub-developer (system design, implementation, and assessment; the old ideation-hub-system-design name still resolves).
